comments.interfaces: List of network interfaces to capture on (e.g., eth0, wlan0)
comments.max_packets: Maximum number of packets to capture (0 for infinite)
comments.duration: Maximum duration in seconds (0 for infinite)
comments.flush_interval: Interval in seconds to flush data to disk
comments.max_file_size: Maximum file size in MB before rotation
comments.rotation_interval: Time interval in seconds before file rotation
comments.sample_rate: Packet sampling rate (1 = all packets, 2 = every other packet, etc.)

preset_filters.web_traffic: tcp and (port 80 or port 443 or port 8080)
preset_filters.email_traffic: tcp and (port 25 or port 110 or port 143 or port 993 or port 995)
